page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-8-highlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 8 dedicated virtual CPUs. The system is equipped with 63.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of approximately 7.88 GB per core.

A primary characteristic of this instance type is its integrated local storage configuration. It includes 3758 GB of local NVMe SSD capacity. This high-density local storage is bundled directly with the instance, offering high-throughput and low-latency storage access directly attached to the hypervisor. The instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or GPU accelerators.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the z4d-highmem-8-highlssd balances dedicated compute resources with a high ratio of local NVMe storage and memory per vCPU. This resource density makes it suitable for workloads requiring fast local scratch space, high-speed database indexing, caching layers, and memory-intensive data processing. Appropriate workloads include relational databases, NoSQL stores, and localized data analytics pipelines.
